settings.default_intro: Every Velora piece currently in season — dresses, outerwear, knitwear and accessories — in one place.
settings.aeo_col1_body: All Velora garments use consistent UK sizing from XS to XL. Knitwear and outerwear are cut with slightly more ease than dresses — check each product's Size Guide tab for exact measurements before ordering.
settings.aeo_col2_body: Orders over ₹4,000 ship free across India in 3-5 business days. Unworn items with tags attached can be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery.
